subject: Quick recap + two questions on next steps
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@olivetech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Quick recap + two questions on next steps

Hi Sara — great to meet you and Marco earlier today. Thanks for walking me through OliveTech's ingestion pipeline and the Q3 goals on reducing inference cost while keeping 95th-percentile latency under 120ms.

Below is a very short recap and two quick questions so we can agree next steps.

Recap (5 bullets):
- Current: mix of on-prem GPU serving + cloud VMs for burst traffic (~50 req/s at peak).
- Pain: unpredictable tail latency during batch requeues and high per-token cost on the longest-context models.
- Goal: pin budget for Q3 pilot and validate a 30% reduction in per-token cost while meeting client latency SLOs.
- Constraint: procurement needs an initial security questionnaire and a procurement owner.
- Success metric: pilot demonstrates cost savings >=25% on production-like workload.

Two quick questions:
1) Is this pilot still on the roadmap for Q3 given your timeline and FY planning?
2) If so, who on your side should I follow up with for the SOC2 + procurement packet (I can send a compact bundle)?

If it helps, I attached the discovery notes and a one-pager outlining a 4-week pilot scope (attachment: discovery-notes.pdf).

Happy to jump on a 20–30 min call next week to lock scope. My calendar link: https://redwoodinference.app/meet/michael-grant

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Sara — short bump before I close out the thread for this quarter. If it helps, here are two light-weight next steps depending on priority:

- If still interested this quarter: quick technical pilot (4 weeks) — we scope with your engineering lead and provide a fixed-cost proposal.
- If deprioritized: a 15-minute feedback call so we understand blockers and whether this should be revisited in Q4.

If I don't hear back, I'll assume the pilot isn't on the immediate roadmap and will follow up again in August.

Hi Michael — apologies for the radio silence. We've had a few internal shifts and I wanted to be sure before responding.

Short answer: we are pausing the pilot conversation for now and moving the initiative to Q4. A few notes on why:
- Priority change: leadership is reallocating budget to a latency-focused initiative for external-facing search (higher immediate ROI).
- Cost sensitivity: initial estimations look promising but our finance lead wants a clearer unit-cost projection tied to expected throughput.
- Security/procurement: procurement would like a one-pager on data flow and retention (we'll need that for the Q4 packet).

Useful feedback on fit: the value proposition is aligned with our goals, but timing and a tighter TCO estimate are deciding factors. I attached a short internal note summarizing where this landed on our roadmap (attachment: olivetech-priority-onepager.pdf).

Let's plan to reopen in early Oct — I'll reach back out once the budget review is done. If you'd like a quick 15-minute call now, I can do next Wed 10–10:30am PT to give verbal feedback.

Thanks for following up and for the clear recap.

Best,
Sara Liu
Head of Data & AI | OliveTech
